# SabKuch
Free online tools — no signup, no watermarks. Everything runs in the user's browser; files never leave the device.
URL: https://sabkuchtools.github.io/sabkuch/
32 tools across 10 categories: Image Tools, Text Tools, Calculators, Converters, Generators, Developer Tools, Color Tools, Date & Time, Social Media, Fun Tools.
Popular: Image Compressor, Word Counter, QR Generator, Password Generator, BMI Calculator, Unit Converter.
Open source: https://github.com/sabkuchtools/sabkuch
